title: Expedited QIO Determination Requests — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
**Rule.** Only the resident or the resident's representative can ask the Quality Improvement Organization for an expedited determination; the business office logs the request the resident makes and never files it on the resident's behalf. A request is timely when it is made no later than the QIO request deadline hour, local time, on the calendar day that falls the QIO request deadline days before the last covered date printed on the NOMNC. A timely request moves the coverage to under appeal, and the resident is not billed for days after the last covered date while the review is pending; a late request is logged as submitted late, leaves the coverage in notice issued and gives no protection from liability. If the QIO reverses, coverage returns to active, the last covered date is cleared and booking continues. If the QIO upholds a timely request, coverage ends on the later of the NOMNC's last covered date and the QIO decision date.

The appeal belongs to the resident under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage; the business office records it.

### Timeliness on hypothetical dates (deadline 1 day before, at hour 12, from the schedule)

| Last covered date on the NOMNC | Request made | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The 24th | The 23rd at 11:40 local time | Timely — coverage moves to under appeal |
| The 24th | The 23rd at 12:00 local time | Timely — no later than the deadline hour |
| The 24th | The 23rd at 14:05 local time | Late — logged as submitted late; coverage stays notice issued |

### Outcomes of a timely request

| QIO decision | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Reverses | Returns to active; last covered date cleared; booking continues |
| Upholds | Ends on the later of the NOMNC's last covered date and the QIO decision date |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a timely request on a notice with last covered date the 24th, upheld on the 27th, ends coverage on the 27th.
